# Was the Atlassian Bitbucket and login outage on Nov 23 a hack?

**Not established.** Not established. Atlassian says only that it has identified the cause and is working on a fix, and it has not said what the cause is. No one has claimed an attack and we found no report calling it one, but no source has ruled one out.

Incident: Atlassian Bitbucket and login outage, Nov 23, 2026. Also reported as the Bitbucket outage and the Atlassian login outage. First published Nov 23, 2026; last updated Nov 23, 2026, 11:12 AM ET.

## The latest

Nov 23, 2026, 11:12 AM ET: **Atlassian's Bitbucket and sign-in outage has been going since 10:19 AM ET on Nov 23. Atlassian has not said what caused it.** First draft. 6 sources (3 Tier 1, 3 Tier 3), 9 claims (3 Confirmed, 2 Reported, 4 Not established), 5 questions. The incident and its start are confirmed by Atlassian's own status page. No cause, claim of responsibility or user count found, so the hack question is Not established. The incident was still open at the time of writing. Privacy check done: no names of private people, no handles, no contact details.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Large. Potential reach is broad among developers: Bitbucket and Atlassian sign-in are widely used by software teams. Atlassian lists only a partial outage, and it had run about an hour at last check. It has not said how many customers were hit.
- Who is affected: Developers and teams who sign in through Atlassian's OAuth service or run Bitbucket Pipelines, from 10:19 AM ET on Monday, Nov 23. The incident was still open at our last check.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 10:19 AM | Incident opened (ET) | Per Atlassian's status page |
| 2 | Components in partial outage | Authentication and Pipelines |

### Known so far

- Atlassian's Bitbucket status page opened an incident at 10:19 AM ET on Nov 23 for failing OAuth token requests, and it was still open at 11:12 AM ET.
- The incident lists Authentication and user management and Pipelines as partial outages; the Bitbucket website, API and Git access show operational.
- Atlassian says it has identified the cause and is working on a mitigation. It has not said what the cause is.

### Not known yet

- What caused the outage. Atlassian has not said.
- Whether it was an attack. No one has claimed one and Atlassian has not addressed it.
- How many customers were affected.
- When it will be fixed.
